main.description: Retract an active local label application after review. Instance authority and actor identity come from the authenticated service context, never request fields. A removal action, imported decision, or author self-label is not a valid target and returns InvalidDecision.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; authenticate with an authorized service account before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated actor lacks permission; do not retry unless its moderation authority changes.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request is incomplete, including a missing reviewedSubject when a current post exists; correct it before retrying.

errors.name: DecisionNotFound
errors.description: The referenced local label action does not exist; refetch getSubjectState before choosing an action to retry.

errors.name: InvalidDecision
errors.description: The target is not an active local label application; select a valid local decision before retrying.

errors.name: ContentChanged
errors.description: The reviewed post CID changed; refetch getSubjectState and re-inspect the current content before retrying.

errors.name: StateConflict
errors.description: expectedVersion is stale; refetch getSubjectState before retrying with the new version.

errors.name: IdempotencyConflict
errors.description: The same key was reused with a different request; do not retry with that key.

errors.name: UnsupportedReason
errors.description: The reason is not supported for this action; choose a supported reason before retrying.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service is temporarily unavailable; retry later.

input.description: Request to retract an active local content-label action

actionId.description: Opaque identifier of the active local label application to retract

expectedVersion.description: Opaque subject-state version expected by the caller

idempotencyKey.description: Opaque key that makes equivalent label-retraction requests idempotent

reason.description: Public reason classification for retracting the label

reviewedSubject.description: Inspected current post; required when one exists and allowed absent when deleted or unavailable

privateNote.description: Private administrative note retained only on the admin action
